version_check: official FerretDB release and exact server binary version output must match 2.7.0 before formal campaign
reset_strategy: fresh FerretDB process; reset all MongoDB collections via documentdb_api.drop_database() in PostgreSQL database postgres; preserve matched extensions and pg_cron state
runtime_auth: disabled with FERRETDB_AUTH=false; authentication is outside this target profile
feedback_mode: AFLNet -n, with queue retention patched to accept novel MongoDB response-state sequences
coverage_interpretation: AFL bitmap is not FerretDB source coverage; report it separately from protocol-state paths
